faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Bhopal (IISER Bhopal) for filling up research project positions under Dr. Ajit Chande.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised in IISER Bhopal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Project Associate II, offering candidates an opportunity to work on an ANRF funded research project in the field of science and technology.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Project Associate II?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Associate II position under advertisement number SERB/BIO/2024-2025/42/02.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for IISER Bhopal Project Associate II?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form and complete all required application steps for the Project Associate II position is 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a four-year Bachelor's degree in Natural Sciences, Engineering, Technology, or Medicine, or a Master's degree in Natural or Life Sciences along with two years of R&D experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for IISER Bhopal Project Associate II recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is set at 30 years for general category candidates, with applicable age relaxations of up to 5 years for SC, ST, and PwD applicants.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary or stipend offered for the Project Associate II post?
faq.answer: Selected NET/GATE qualified candidates receive Rs. 35,000/- per month plus HRA, while non-qualified candidates receive Rs. 28,000/- per month plus HRA @ 18%.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for IISER Bhopal recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly online. Candidates need to fill out the designated Google form and submit their CV along with referee details before the deadline.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for IISER Bhopal Project Associate II?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their submitted applications and CVs, followed by an interview round for the shortlisted individuals.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification PDF, application links, and the official website links in the Important Links section of this article.
